paragraphs.text: Urgoros is a specter from Vhelnish on Dominaria , who serves Belzenlok .

When the demonlord Belzenlok bestowed the dark "blessings" of dementia magic upon his followers, many died or were transformed into monstrosities. Urgoros's fate, however, was unique: his body was siphoned away into dementia space , but his spirit was fused into his armor. Mounted on a nightmare -steed, his specter terrorized the skies of Urborg , punishing all who dared defy the demonlord.
Urgoros was the second defense against the attack of the Skyship Weatherlight against the Stronghold . He lived inside an Urborg volcano. He vanished when Belzenlok died.
